label: Diagram 3.7
caption: Diagram 3.7 | Access to through floor lift | Private stairs and changes of level within the dwelling
description: This is a plan view, headed in a green footer as "Diagram 3.7 Access to through floor lift". At the top, two parallel horizontal lines form a wall with no opening. To the upper left the open space is labelled "Circulation area". A large dashed circle occupies the upper portion of the plan and is pointed to by the label "1500mm clear turning circle". At the top of the lift space a door is drawn swung open into the circulation area, its hinge at the upper-left corner of the lift space and its swing arc shown within the turning circle. Below the door, a rectangle marked with diagonal cross lines represents the lift, labelled "Lift or future lift space". A vertical dimension line to the left of this rectangle reads "1650mm", and a horizontal dimension line beneath it reads "1100mm". To the right of the plan is a text block reading "Notes: 1. All doors to be power operated. 2. Turning circle should be clear of top step of any adjacent flight of steps.*" In small type at the lower right is "*all dimensions are minimum except where noted". The dashed circle overlaps the upper edge of the lift rectangle and the circulation area.
